name: Real Estate Lead Intake — n8n Template

parameters.content:
## Real Estate Lead Intake

Receives property inquiries via webhook, classifies them with GPT-4o-mini (urgency, type, budget), logs to Google Sheets, and sends a personalized first reply within 60 seconds.

**Setup:** Point your web form to POST to the webhook URL shown in the Receive Lead node.

**Validation**

Checks that name, email or phone, and message are all present. Invalid submissions are logged to the Error Log sheet and silently dropped - the lead is never lost, just flagged.

**Customize AI Prompt**

Edit the 'Build AI Prompt' node to change classification labels, reply language, or agency name. The prompt is injected at runtime - no changes needed in the OpenAI node itself.

**Customize Reply Email**

Edit the subject and body template in 'Build Reply Email'. The variable `$json.first_reply_text` is the AI-generated reply. Wrap it in your brand HTML or keep it plain text.

**Error Branches**

All API errors (OpenAI, Sheets, Gmail) and validation failures land in the 'Error Log' node with a structured record. Extend by connecting a Slack or email alert node after 'Error Log'.

assignments.name: error_message
assignments.value: Validation failed: name, contact (email or phone), and message (>5 chars) are all required.

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value: =Analyze this real estate inquiry and return ONLY valid JSON with these exact keys: property_type (one of rent/buy/sell/info), urgency (one of hot/warm/cold), budget_range (e.g. ?1200/month or unknown), first_reply_text (2-3 sentence warm reply in same language as message, acknowledge inquiry, promise follow-up within 24 hours, sign off as The Agency Team). Lead name: {{ $json.name }}. Source: {{ $json.source }}. Message: {{ $json.message }}

messages.content: You are a real estate assistant. Respond only in valid JSON.

assignments.name: subject
assignments.value: =Re: Your property inquiry - we received your message
